subtitles.en: And this idea is not necessarily a new one, the real headline in the report from the financial times from overnight was the size of the stake, the 5%. We've previously reported, and other
subtitles.zh: 这个想法并不新鲜，金融时报隔夜报道的真正重点是5%的持股比例。我们之前报道过，其他媒体也报道过，AI公司，尤其是OpenAI，曾提出给政府一部分业务股份的想法。
zh_highlights: 给政府一部分业务股份

subtitles.en: outlets have too, that, you know, the AI companies, especially OpenAI, have floated this idea of giving the government a piece of their business, giving them shares to see what would be a public
subtitles.zh: 给他们股份，用于设立一个公共福利基金，重新分配AI繁荣的部分收益，或许还能解决一些担忧，即技术带来的新财富和经济混乱。
zh_highlights: 重新分配AI繁荣的部分收益

subtitles.en: benefit fund to redistribute some of the gains from the AI boom, and maybe address some of the concerns that all of this newfound wealth and economic dislocation brought by the technology
subtitles.zh: 通过这个工具分享收益，可以减轻AI浪潮的冲击。政府也对此有所讨论。上个月，特朗普总统在空军一号上接受采访时表示支持这个想法，但没有提供具体细节，只说与一些行业官员进行了会谈。

subtitles.en: that that could somehow be soft. And the blow from the AI roller could be minimized by sharing the gains a little bit through this vehicle. And the administration has talked about this a little
subtitles.zh: 目前尚不清楚政府与公司之间的谈判是否真正活跃或取得进展。目前看来，这更像是该公司在IPO前试图确定持股规模。他们还设想让其他AI实验室，如Anthropic或谷歌的DeepMind也参与进来。

subtitles.en: bit. President Donald Trump embraced the idea when asked by our own Amory Horde Dern last month on Air Force One, but the president offered no specifics beyond just saying that he had been
subtitles.zh: 总统特朗普上个月在空军一号上被我们的记者问及此事时，表示支持这个想法，但未提供具体细节，仅称他一直在考虑。

subtitles.en: in talks with some industry officials. And it's unclear whether negotiations really active or advancing between the government and the company. It seems more right now that this is something the company
subtitles.zh: 与一些行业官员进行谈判。目前尚不清楚政府与公司之间的谈判是否真正活跃或取得进展。目前看来，这更像是公司方面

subtitles.en: is really trying to work out ahead of its IPO, to come up with what the size of a stake could look like. What they're also envisioning is having other AI labs, such as Anthropic or Google's Deep
subtitles.zh: 在IPO前，OpenAI正努力确定政府持股规模，并设想其他AI实验室如Anthropic或谷歌DeepMind也参与其中。
